## 1. Research Question & Related Work

Using loan and borrower characteristics identified in prior research, we explore **factors other than credit grade that explain delinquency or default risk and examine whether their associations with risk vary over the life of the loan**.

- RQ1: How do Kaplan–Meier curves based on proxy event times differ by credit grade?
- RQ2: Does each literature-based covariate group (A, B, and C) provide additional explanatory information after accounting for credit grade and origination year?
- RQ3: (How) do the associations for key factors in each covariate group differ between the early and late periods?

#### Related Work

[Serrano-Cinca et al. (2015), Determinants of Default in P2P Lending](https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0139427) provides the rationale for examining credit grade, income, loan purpose, credit history, and debt measures. The study found that credit grade (`grade`) was the most important predictor of default and that accounting for borrowers’ debt burden improved prediction.

- We extend prior work by assessing the incremental explanatory value beyond credit grade, adjusting for multiple covariates, examining how their associations with delinquency or default change over time, and accounting for repayment in full as a competing event.

[Li et al. (2023)](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ejor.2022.08.013) motivates distinguishing loan distress from completed repayment. We use `cmprsk` in the supplementary sections for cumulative incidence and Gray tests.

```{r}
hr_table <- function(model) {
  z <- summary(model)
  data.frame(term = rownames(z$coefficients), beta = z$coefficients[, "coef"],
    se = z$coefficients[, "se(coef)"], HR = z$conf.int[, "exp(coef)"],
    lower = z$conf.int[, "lower .95"], upper = z$conf.int[, "upper .95"],
    p_value = z$coefficients[, "Pr(>|z|)"], row.names = NULL)
}

ph_table <- function(model, label) {
  cox.zph(model)$table %>% as.data.frame() %>%
    { data.frame(term = rownames(.), ., row.names = NULL) } %>%
    mutate(model = label, .before = 1) %>% rename(p_value = p)
}
    
# Record convergence problems instead of silently interpreting unstable fits.
checked_coxph <- function(formula, data, label, ...) {
  notes <- character()
  fit <- withCallingHandlers(
    coxph(formula, data = data, model = TRUE, ...),
    warning = function(w) {
      notes <<- c(notes, conditionMessage(w))
      invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    })
  attr(fit, "analysis_warnings") <- unique(notes)
  fit
}
fit_status <- function(model, label) {
  notes <- attr(model, "analysis_warnings")
  bad_warning <- any(grepl("infinite|did not converge|converged before", notes, ignore.case = TRUE))
  data.frame(model = label, n = model$n, events = model$nevent,
    parameters = length(coef(model)), fit_ok = all(is.finite(coef(model))) && !bad_warning,
    warning = paste(notes, collapse = " | "))
}

# PSOCK creates independent R sessions; no fork is used.
start_analysis_cluster <- function(workers, exports, envir = parent.frame()) {
  cluster <- parallel::makePSOCKcluster(as.integer(workers), rscript_args = "--vanilla")
  success <- FALSE
  on.exit(if (!success) parallel::stopCluster(cluster), add = TRUE)
  parallel::clusterCall(cluster, function(paths) { .libPaths(paths); NULL }, .libPaths())
  parallel::clusterCall(cluster, base::options, options("contrasts", "na.action"))
  parallel::clusterEvalQ(cluster, {
    suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(survival))
    suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(dplyr))
    NULL
  })
  parallel::clusterCall(cluster, base::setwd, getwd())
  export_env <- new.env(parent = emptyenv())
  for (name in exports) {
    value <- get(name, envir = envir, inherits = TRUE)
    # Avoid serializing the entire Positron/knitr session with helper closures.
    if (is.function(value)) environment(value) <- globalenv()
    assign(name, value, envir = export_env)
  }
  parallel::clusterExport(cluster, exports, envir = export_env)
  success <- TRUE
  cluster
}

model_formula <- function(variables, structure = c("initial", "piecewise")) {
  structure <- match.arg(structure)
  response <- if (structure == "initial") "Surv(duration_months, event)" else "Surv(tstart, tstop, event_piece)"
  fixed <- if (structure == "initial") c("grade", "strata(issue_year)") else "strata(year_grade)"
  as.formula(paste(response, "~", paste(c(fixed, variables), collapse = " + ")), env = globalenv())
}
```

## 2. Data Definition and Preprocessing Checks

The unit of analysis is an individual approved and originated personal loan. Loans were originated from June 2007 through December 2015, and follow-up ended in January 2016.

- The event (`event=1`) includes both Late categories, Default, and Charged Off. The last payment month serves as a proxy for the event month.
- Loans classified as Current or In Grace Period are censored in January 2016. Fully Paid loans are censored in their last payment month.
- For `event_type`, 0 indicates the end of follow-up, 1 indicates the event, and 2 indicates repayment in full. The regression models use `event`.
- The data do not capture prior delinquencies that were subsequently resolved or the exact month of first delinquency.
- Repayment in full precludes subsequent delinquency or default on the loan, so the actual cumulative event probability requires accounting for this competing event. The Kaplan–Meier quantity 1−S treats repayment in full as censoring.

```{r}
#| label: data-load
dat <- data.table::fread("pre_loan.csv", encoding = "UTF-8", data.table = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(row_id = row_number(), 
         grade = factor(grade, levels = LETTERS[1:7]),
         across(all_of(c("term_months", "purpose", "home_ownership",
                         "emp_length", "issue_year")), factor),
         dti10 = dti / 10, util10 = revol_util / 10,
         delinq_any = as.integer(delinq_2yrs > 0), 
         pubrec_any = as.integer(pub_rec > 0),
         log_revol_bal = log1p(revol_bal), open_acc10 = open_acc / 10,
         total_acc10 = total_acc / 10,
         year_grade = interaction(issue_year, grade, sep = ":", drop = TRUE))
```

## 3. K-M estimator and log-rank test (RQ1)

- The 12-, 24-, and 36-month time points were chosen for summarization and visualization.

```{r}
#| label: km-curves
km <- survfit(Surv(duration_months, event) ~ grade, data = dat)
km_curve_summary <- summary(km, censored = TRUE)
km_curve <- data.frame(
  grade = sub("^grade=", "", as.character(km_curve_summary$strata)),
  month = km_curve_summary$time,
  KM_survival = km_curve_summary$surv
) %>%
  bind_rows(data.frame(grade = levels(dat$grade), month = 0, KM_survival = 1)) %>%
  arrange(grade, month)

# visualization

                   D = "#537A98", E = "#406480", F = "#2C4C65", G = "#172F43")
km_end_labels <- km_curve %>%
  filter(month <= 36) %>%
  group_by(grade) %>%
  slice_max(month, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>% as.data.frame()
km_plot <- km_curve %>%
  filter(month <= 36) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = month, y = KM_survival, colour = grade)) +
  geom_step(linewidth = .9) +
  geom_text(data = km_end_labels, aes(x = 36.7, label = grade),
            hjust = 0, size = 4, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +

  labs(title = "KM survival by credit grade",
       subtitle = "Approved individual loans | grades A-G | first 36 months",
       x = "Months since origination", y = "KM survival",
       caption = "Fully Paid loans are censored at the last payment month.
Event times use last-payment proxies; 1 - KM survival is not the actual cumulative event probability.") +
```

## 4. Nested Model Comparisons by Covariate Group (RQ2)

- We also tried AIC-based stepwise selection. It retained most covariates and therefore offered little simplification. Nested model comparisons by covariate group directly address whether each literature-based group adds explanatory value after accounting for credit grade and origination year.

- **A — Financial Characteristics and Debt Burden:** `annual_inc`, `dti`, `revol_util`, `revol_bal`

- **B — Loan Contract Characteristics:** `term_months`, `loan_amnt`, `int_rate`, `purpose`

- **C — Credit History and Borrower Background:** `delinq_2yrs`, `pub_rec`, `inq_last_6mths`, `open_acc`, `total_acc`, `home_ownership`, `emp_length`

The baseline model `M0` includes `grade` as a covariate and stratifies by `issue_year`.

$$M_0:\quad h(t\mid G,Y)=h_{0,Y}(t)\exp\left(\beta_G^{\top}G\right).$$

We used likelihood ratio tests to compare nested models fitted to the same data with the same stratification. The degrees of freedom equal the number of added regression coefficients. We adjusted the p-values using the Holm method.

```{r}
#| label: grouped-model-definition
candidate_variables <- c("term_months", "log_loan_amnt", "int_rate", "purpose", "log_annual_inc",
  "dti10", "util10", "delinq_any", "pubrec_any", "inq_last_6mths", "log_revol_bal",
  "open_acc10", "total_acc10", "home_ownership", "emp_length")

variable_dictionary <- data.frame(variable = candidate_variables,
  rationale = c("Loan term", "Loan amount (log scale)", "Annual interest rate", "Loan purpose", "Annual income (log scale)",
    "DTI (per 10 percentage points)", "Revolving credit utilization (per 10 percentage points)", "Any delinquency in the past 2 years", "Any public record",
    "Number of inquiries in the past 6 months", "Revolving credit balance (log(1 + x))", "Open accounts (per 10 accounts)",
    "Total accounts (per 10 accounts)", "Homeownership", "Employment length"))

group_variables <- list(
  A = c("log_annual_inc", "dti10", "util10", "log_revol_bal"),
  B = c("term_months", "log_loan_amnt", "int_rate", "purpose"),
  C = c("delinq_any", "pubrec_any", "inq_last_6mths", "open_acc10", "total_acc10",
        "home_ownership", "emp_length"))
stopifnot(setequal(unlist(group_variables), candidate_variables),
  !anyDuplicated(unlist(group_variables)))

analysis_variables <- candidate_variables

variables_for <- function(groups) candidate_variables[candidate_variables %in% unlist(group_variables[groups])]

model_specs <- list(M0 = character(), MA = variables_for("A"), MB = variables_for("B"),
  MC = variables_for("C"), MAB = variables_for(c("A", "B")),
  MAC = variables_for(c("A", "C")), MBC = variables_for(c("B", "C")),
  MABC = variables_for(c("A", "B", "C")))

group_membership <- bind_rows(lapply(names(group_variables), function(g)
  data.frame(group = g, variable = group_variables[[g]]))) %>%
  left_join(variable_dictionary, by = "variable") %>% as.data.frame()
group_membership
save_table(group_membership, "group_membership")

analysis_data_hash <- function(dataset) {
  columns <- intersect(c("grade", "issue_year", "year_grade", candidate_variables,
    "duration_months", "event", "tstart", "tstop", "event_piece"), names(dataset))
  path <- tempfile(fileext = ".rds")
  on.exit(unlink(path), add = TRUE)
  saveRDS(dataset %>% select(all_of(columns)), path, compress = FALSE)
  unname(tools::md5sum(path))
}
                                     
group_fit_one <- function(variables, structure, dataset, data_id, model_name) {
  formula <- model_formula(variables, structure)
  signature <- paste(input_hash, data_id, model_name, paste(deparse(formula), collapse = " "),
    as.character(packageVersion("survival")),
    paste(capture.output(dput(options("contrasts"))), collapse = " "),
    paste(deparse(body(group_fit_one)), collapse = "\n"), "nested;efron;v1", collapse = "|")
  tmp <- tempfile(); writeLines(signature, tmp)
  key <- unname(tools::md5sum(tmp)); unlink(tmp)
  path <- file.path(cache_dir, paste0("nested_", key, ".rds"))
  is_full <- model_name == "MABC"
  if (!is_full && use_fit_cache && file.exists(path)) {
    return(list(metrics = as.data.frame(readRDS(path)), fit = NULL))
  }
  fit <- checked_coxph(formula, dataset, label = model_name, ties = "efron",
    x = is_full, y = is_full)
  stopifnot(fit$n == nrow(dataset))
  status <- fit_status(fit, model_name)
  metrics <- data.frame(n = fit$n, events = fit$nevent,
    log_likelihood = as.numeric(logLik(fit)), parameters = attr(logLik(fit), "df"),
    AIC = AIC(fit), fit_ok = status$fit_ok, warning = status$warning)
  if (use_fit_cache) saveRDS(metrics, path)
  list(metrics = metrics, fit = if (is_full) fit else NULL)
}
       
fit_group_set <- function(datasets, structure, label) {
  ids <- paste(label, seq_along(datasets), vapply(datasets, analysis_data_hash, character(1)), sep = ":")
  rows <- list(); full_fits <- NULL
  n_loans <- length(unique(unlist(lapply(datasets, function(d) d$row_id))))
  for (name in names(model_specs)) {
    runs <- lapply(seq_along(datasets), function(i)
      group_fit_one(model_specs[[name]], structure, datasets[[i]], ids[i], name))
    m <- bind_rows(lapply(runs, function(z) z$metrics))
    stopifnot(all(m$fit_ok))
    rows[[name]] <- data.frame(model = name, n_loans = n_loans, n_intervals = sum(m$n),
      events = sum(m$events), log_likelihood = sum(m$log_likelihood),
      parameters = sum(m$parameters), AIC = sum(m$AIC), fit_ok = all(m$fit_ok))
    if (name == "MABC") full_fits <- lapply(runs, function(z) z$fit)
  }
  metrics <- bind_rows(rows) %>% as.data.frame()
  stopifnot(length(unique(metrics$n_intervals)) == 1L, length(unique(metrics$events)) == 1L)
  list(metrics = metrics, full_fits = full_fits)
}
                                        
nested_lr_table <- function(metrics) {
  pairs <- data.frame(
    family = c(rep("baseline_addition", 3), rep("conditional_contribution", 3), rep("sequential", 3), "all_groups"),
    group = c("A", "B", "C", "A", "B", "C", "A", "B", "C", "A+B+C"),
    null_model = c("M0", "M0", "M0", "MBC", "MAC", "MAB", "M0", "MA", "MAB", "M0"),
    alternative_model = c("MA", "MB", "MC", "MABC", "MABC", "MABC", "MA", "MAB", "MABC", "MABC"))
  stopifnot(all(vapply(seq_len(nrow(pairs)), function(i)
    all(model_specs[[pairs$null_model[i]]] %in% model_specs[[pairs$alternative_model[i]]]), logical(1))))
  null <- metrics[match(pairs$null_model, metrics$model), ]
  alt <- metrics[match(pairs$alternative_model, metrics$model), ]
  stopifnot(all(null$n_intervals == alt$n_intervals), all(null$events == alt$events),
    all(alt$log_likelihood - null$log_likelihood >= -1e-5), all(alt$parameters > null$parameters))
  pairs %>% mutate(LR = pmax(0, 2 * (alt$log_likelihood - null$log_likelihood)),
    df = alt$parameters - null$parameters, p_value = pchisq(LR, df, lower.tail = FALSE),
    delta_AIC = alt$AIC - null$AIC) %>% group_by(family) %>%
    mutate(p_holm = p.adjust(p_value, method = "holm")) %>% ungroup() %>%
    mutate(p_display = format.pval(p_value, digits = 3, eps = .001),
      p_holm_display = format.pval(p_holm, digits = 3, eps = .001)) %>% as.data.frame()
}
                       
group_slide_table <- function(tests, stage) {
  b <- tests %>% filter(family == "baseline_addition") %>%
    select(group, base_LR = LR, base_df = df, baseline_p_Holm = p_holm_display)
  c <- tests %>% filter(family == "conditional_contribution") %>%
    select(group, cond_LR = LR, cond_df = df, conditional_p_Holm = p_holm_display)
  b %>% left_join(c, by = "group") %>% mutate(stage = stage,
    n_variables = vapply(group, function(g) length(group_variables[[g]]), integer(1)),
    baseline_LR_df = sprintf("%.2f (%d)", base_LR, as.integer(base_df)),
    conditional_LR_df = sprintf("%.2f (%d)", cond_LR, as.integer(cond_df))) %>%
    select(stage, group, n_variables, baseline_LR_df, baseline_p_Holm,
      conditional_LR_df, conditional_p_Holm) %>% as.data.frame()
}
```

## 5. MABC Regression Diagnostics (RQ2)

### Overall Model Fit with Cox–Snell Residuals

```{r}
#| label: initial-regression-diagnostics
initial_martingale <- as.numeric(residuals(m_initial, type = "martingale"))
initial_cox_snell <- pmax(0, dat$event - initial_martingale)
initial_cs_fit <- survfit(Surv(initial_cox_snell, dat$event) ~ 1, stype = 2, ctype = 1, se.fit = FALSE)
initial_cs_keep <- unique(round(seq(1, length(initial_cs_fit$time), length.out = min(2000L, length(initial_cs_fit$time)))))
initial_cs_data <- data.frame(residual = initial_cs_fit$time[initial_cs_keep],
  cumulative_hazard = initial_cs_fit$cumhaz[initial_cs_keep])
initial_cs_plot <- initial_cs_data %>% filter(residual <= quantile(initial_cox_snell, .99)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(residual, cumulative_hazard)) + geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "#A7854E") +
  geom_step(colour = "#537A98", linewidth = .8) + coord_equal() +
  labs(title = "Initial MABC: Cox-Snell diagnostic", x = "Cox-Snell residual", y = "Nelson-Aalen cumulative hazard") +
  project_plot_theme()
initial_cs_plot
save_figure(initial_cs_plot, "initial_cox_snell")
save_table(initial_cs_data, "initial_cox_snell")
```

### Functional Form of Continuous Covariates with Martingale Residuals

Following pages 8–10 of the lecture PDF, we plot martingale residuals from initial models that omit either DTI or log income. We use means within quantile groups and LOWESS to assess curvature, taking into account correlations among covariates and the limited range of the residuals.

```{r}
#| label: initial-martingale-shape
set.seed(20261118)
scatter_rows <- sample.int(nrow(dat), min(15000L, nrow(dat)))
initial_mart_bins <- list(); initial_mart_points <- list()
for (variable in c("dti10", "log_annual_inc")) {
  reduced_terms <- setdiff(analysis_variables, variable)
  reduced_formula <- as.formula(paste("Surv(duration_months, event) ~",
    paste(c("grade", "strata(issue_year)", reduced_terms), collapse = " + ")))
  reduced_model <- coxph(reduced_formula, data = dat, ties = "efron")
  z <- data.frame(value = dat[[variable]], martingale = as.numeric(residuals(reduced_model, type = "martingale")))
  initial_mart_points[[variable]] <- z %>% slice(scatter_rows) %>% mutate(variable = variable)
  breaks <- unique(quantile(z$value, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = 81)))
  bins <- z %>% mutate(bin = cut(value, breaks, include.lowest = TRUE)) %>% group_by(bin) %>%
    summarise(value = mean(value), martingale = mean(martingale), n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% arrange(value) %>% as.data.frame()
  smoothed <- lowess(bins$value, bins$martingale, f = .35)
  bins <- bins %>% mutate(smooth = approx(smoothed$x, smoothed$y, xout = value, ties = mean, rule = 2)$y,
                          variable = variable)
  initial_mart_bins[[variable]] <- bins
  rm(reduced_model)
}
initial_mart_bins <- bind_rows(initial_mart_bins)
initial_mart_points <- bind_rows(initial_mart_points)
initial_mart_limits <- data.frame(variable = c("dti10", "log_annual_inc"),
  xmax = c(unname(quantile(dat$dti10, .995)), unname(quantile(dat$log_annual_inc, .995))))
initial_mart_plot <- initial_mart_points %>% left_join(initial_mart_limits, by = "variable") %>% filter(value <= xmax) %>%
  ggplot(aes(value, martingale)) + geom_point(alpha = .08, size = .5, colour = "#537A98") +
  geom_line(data = initial_mart_bins %>% left_join(initial_mart_limits, by = "variable") %>% filter(value <= xmax),
    aes(y = smooth), linewidth = .9, colour = "#CF7653") + facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(title = "Martingale residuals: inspect covariate shape", x = "Transformed covariate value",
    y = "Reduced-model martingale residual", caption = "Scatter: up to 15,000 loans; estimation and bin means: all loans. Central 99.5% x-range shown.") + project_plot_theme()
initial_mart_zoom <- initial_mart_bins %>% left_join(initial_mart_limits, by = "variable") %>% filter(value <= xmax) %>%
  ggplot(aes(value, martingale)) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "#A7854E") +
  geom_point(aes(size = n), colour = "#537A98") + geom_line(aes(y = smooth), colour = "#CF7653") +
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free") + scale_size_continuous(guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "Covariate-shape diagnostic: magnified bin means", x = "10-percentage-point units",
    y = "Mean martingale residual", caption = "Y axes differ and magnify small changes; not a formal test or a unique transformation rule.") + project_plot_theme()
initial_mart_plot
initial_mart_zoom
  
save_figure(initial_mart_plot, "initial_martingale")
save_figure(initial_mart_zoom, "initial_martingale_zoom")
save_table(initial_mart_bins, "initial_martingale_binned")
```

## 6. Proportional Hazards Diagnostics and Cutpoint-Based Adjustment (RQ3)

### Graphical Checks of the Proportional Hazards Assumption

**A. Adjusted log cumulative hazard curves.** Approximately parallel curves across grades within the same origination-year panel are consistent with proportional hazards across grades.

```{r}
#| label: initial-ph-log-cumulative-hazard
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8
# Grade-stratified diagnostic fit: other covariate effects are still assumed common.
f_common <- as.formula(paste("Surv(duration_months, event) ~",
  paste(c("strata(year_grade)", analysis_variables), collapse = " + ")))
m_common <- checked_coxph(f_common, data = dat, label = "m_common", ties = "efron", x = TRUE, y = TRUE)
bh <- basehaz(m_common, centered = TRUE) %>% as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(stratum = sub("^year_grade=", "", as.character(strata))) %>%
  separate(stratum, into = c("issue_year", "grade"), sep = ":")
initial_bh_grid <- bh %>% filter(issue_year %in% c("2012", "2013", "2014", "2015")) %>%
  group_by(issue_year, grade) %>% group_modify(~data.frame(time = 1:36,
    hazard = approx(c(0, .x$time), c(0, .x$hazard), xout = 1:36, method = "constant", rule = 1, ties = max)$y)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% filter(!is.na(hazard)) %>% as.data.frame()
  
initial_grade_reference <- initial_bh_grid %>% filter(grade == "A") %>% select(issue_year, time, hazard_A = hazard)
initial_bh_grid <- initial_bh_grid %>% left_join(initial_grade_reference, by = c("issue_year", "time"))
initial_logh_plot <- initial_bh_grid %>% filter(hazard > 0) %>% ggplot(aes(time, log(hazard), colour = grade)) +
  geom_line() + facet_wrap(~issue_year) + scale_colour_manual(values = grade_colours) +
  labs(title = "Initial PH check: adjusted log cumulative hazards", x = "Months", y = "Log cumulative hazard",
    caption = "Parallel curves would support PH across grades within a cohort. Sparse cells and short follow-up limit interpretation.") + project_plot_theme()

initial_logh_plot
save_figure(initial_logh_plot, "04a_initial_ph_log_cumulative_hazard", height = 8)
save_table(initial_bh_grid, "initial_ph_baseline_grid")
```

**B. Cumulative score processes.** Under proportional hazards, the processes are expected to fluctuate around zero without a systematic pattern.

```{r}
#| label: initial-ph-score-process
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8
initial_score_terms <- c("dti10", "util10", "log_annual_inc", "log_revol_bal", "inq_last_6mths")

initial_score_labels <- c(dti10 = "dti (per 10 percentage points)",
  util10 = "revol_util (per 10 percentage points)", log_annual_inc = "log(annual_inc)",
  log_revol_bal = "log(1 + revol_bal)", inq_last_6mths = "inq_last_6mths")

initial_schoenfeld <- residuals(m_initial, type = "schoenfeld")
initial_score_process <- lapply(intersect(initial_score_terms, colnames(initial_schoenfeld)), function(v) {
  data.frame(time = as.numeric(rownames(initial_schoenfeld)), contribution = initial_schoenfeld[, v]) %>%
    group_by(time) %>% summarise(contribution = sum(contribution), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(time) %>% mutate(process = cumsum(contribution) * sqrt(vcov(m_initial)[v, v]),
      term = v, variable = unname(initial_score_labels[v])) %>% as.data.frame()
}) %>% bind_rows() %>% as.data.frame()
  
initial_score_plot <- initial_score_process %>% ggplot(aes(time, process)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "#A7854E") +
  geom_line(colour = "#537A98", linewidth = .65) +
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
  labs(title = "Initial PH check: cumulative score processes", x = "Months since loan issue",
    y = "Standardized cumulative score",
    caption = "Systematic drift suggests departures from PH. No simultaneous confidence bands; panel scales differ.") +
  project_plot_theme()
initial_score_plot
  
save_figure(initial_score_plot, "04b_initial_ph_score_process", height = 8)
save_table(initial_score_process, "initial_ph_score_process")
rm(initial_schoenfeld)
```

### Cutpoint Selection

```{r}
#| label: cutpoint-candidates
cut_min_events <- 5000L
cut_min_late_loans <- 100000L
cut_model_variables <- analysis_variables
cut_model_variables <- analysis_variables
cut_expected_parameters <- 2L * length(coef(m_common))

focus_terms <- intersect(c("dti10", "util10", "log_annual_inc", "log_revol_bal", "inq_last_6mths"), analysis_variables)
cut_event_months <- dat %>% filter(event == 1) %>% distinct(duration_months) %>%
  arrange(duration_months) %>% pull(duration_months)

cut_candidates <- data.frame(tau = cut_event_months) %>%
  mutate(
    events_before = vapply(tau, function(t) sum(dat$event == 1 & dat$duration_months <= t), numeric(1)),
    events_after = sum(dat$event) - events_before,
    loans_after = vapply(tau, function(t) sum(dat$duration_months > t), numeric(1)),
    eligible = events_before >= cut_min_events & events_after >= cut_min_events &
      loans_after >= cut_min_late_loans,
    support_reason = case_when(
      events_before < cut_min_events ~ "too few early events",
      events_after < cut_min_events ~ "too few late events",
      loans_after < cut_min_late_loans ~ "too few loans at late entry",
      TRUE ~ "eligible"))
                           
cut_candidates %>% print(row.names = FALSE)
save_table(cut_candidates, "cutpoint_candidates")
stopifnot(any(cut_candidates$eligible))
```

```{r}
#| label: cutpoint-profile
cutpoint_fit <- function(dataset, stage, tau) {
  formula <- model_formula(cut_model_variables, "piecewise")
  signature <- paste(input_hash, analysis_data_hash(dataset), deparse(formula), stage, tau,
    as.character(packageVersion("survival")), paste(deparse(body(cutpoint_fit)), collapse = "\n"),
    paste(deparse(body(hr_table)), collapse = "\n"), collapse = "|")
  tmp <- tempfile(); writeLines(signature, tmp)
  key <- unname(tools::md5sum(tmp)); unlink(tmp)
  path <- file.path(cache_dir, paste0("cutpoint_", key, ".rds"))
  if (use_fit_cache && file.exists(path)) {
    result <- readRDS(path)
    result$hr <- as.data.frame(result$hr)
    return(result)
  }
  warnings <- character()
  result <- tryCatch({
    model <- withCallingHandlers({
      coxph(formula, data = dataset, ties = "efron", x = FALSE, y = FALSE)
    }, warning = function(w) {
      warnings <<- c(warnings, conditionMessage(w)); invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
    })
    valid <- !anyNA(coef(model)) && all(is.finite(coef(model))) &&
      all(is.finite(diag(vcov(model)))) && all(diag(vcov(model)) > 0) && !length(warnings)
    list(valid = valid, log_likelihood = as.numeric(logLik(model)),
      parameters = sum(!is.na(coef(model))), n = model$n, events = model$nevent,
      hr = if (valid) hr_table(model) else data.frame(),
      reason = if (length(warnings)) paste(unique(warnings), collapse = "; ") else
        if (valid) "ok" else "rank or finite-estimate check failed")
  }, error = function(e) list(valid = FALSE, log_likelihood = NA_real_, parameters = NA_integer_,
      n = nrow(dataset), events = sum(dataset$event_piece), hr = data.frame(), reason = conditionMessage(e)))
  if (use_fit_cache) saveRDS(result, path)
  result
}
         
cutpoint_evaluate <- function(tau) {
  message("Cutpoint profile: ", tau, " months")
  before <- dat %>% mutate(tstart = 0, tstop = pmin(duration_months, tau),
    event_piece = as.integer(event == 1 & duration_months <= tau))
  after <- dat %>% filter(duration_months > tau) %>%
    mutate(tstart = tau, tstop = duration_months, event_piece = event)
  stopifnot(sum(before$event_piece) + sum(after$event_piece) == sum(dat$event),
            all(after$tstart < after$tstop))
  a <- cutpoint_fit(before, "early", tau)
  b <- cutpoint_fit(after, "late", tau)
  comparable <- a$valid && b$valid && a$parameters + b$parameters == cut_expected_parameters
  list(profile = data.frame(tau = tau, valid = comparable,
      log_likelihood = if (comparable) a$log_likelihood + b$log_likelihood else NA_real_,
      parameters = a$parameters + b$parameters,
      early_n = a$n, late_n = b$n, early_events = a$events, late_events = b$events,
      reason = if (comparable) "ok" else paste(a$reason, b$reason, "parameter-count check", sep = "; ")),
    hr = bind_rows(a$hr %>% mutate(period = "Before cut"), b$hr %>% mutate(period = "After cut")) %>%
      mutate(tau = tau))
}
       
cut_tau_values <- cut_candidates %>% filter(eligible) %>% pull(tau)
cut_search_taus <- cut_tau_values
       
cut_search_runs <- if (analysis_workers > 1L && length(cut_search_taus)) {
  cut_cluster <- start_analysis_cluster(analysis_workers,
    c("dat", "candidate_variables", "cut_model_variables", "cut_expected_parameters",
      "input_hash", "cache_dir", "use_fit_cache", "model_formula", "analysis_data_hash",
      "hr_table", "cutpoint_fit", "cutpoint_evaluate"), envir = environment())
  tryCatch({
    task <- eval(quote(function(tau) cutpoint_evaluate(tau)), envir = globalenv())
    parallel::parLapplyLB(cut_cluster, cut_search_taus, task)
  }, finally = parallel::stopCluster(cut_cluster))
} else {
  lapply(cut_search_taus, cutpoint_evaluate)
}
                 
cut_runs <- cut_search_runs
if (any(vapply(cut_runs, inherits, logical(1), "try-error"))) stop("A cutpoint worker failed; inspect warnings.")
                 
cut_profile <- lapply(cut_runs, function(x) x$profile) %>% bind_rows() %>% arrange(tau)
cut_all_hr <- lapply(cut_runs, function(x) x$hr) %>% bind_rows()
stopifnot(any(cut_profile$valid))
                     
cut_max_ll <- max(cut_profile$log_likelihood, na.rm = TRUE)
cut_profile <- cut_profile %>% mutate(
  relative_log_likelihood = log_likelihood - cut_max_ll,
  delta_2loglik = 2 * (cut_max_ll - log_likelihood))
                     
cut_best <- cut_profile %>% filter(valid) %>% arrange(desc(log_likelihood), tau) %>% slice(1)
cut_best_tau <- cut_best$tau
split_month <- as.integer(cut_best_tau)
stopifnot(is.finite(split_month), split_month > 0)
                     
cut_summary <- cut_best %>% mutate(
  candidate_min = min(cut_tau_values), candidate_max = max(cut_tau_values),
  n_eligible = length(cut_tau_values), n_valid = sum(cut_profile$valid),
  boundary_maximum = tau %in% range(cut_profile$tau[cut_profile$valid]),
  n_tied_maxima = sum(abs(cut_profile$log_likelihood - cut_max_ll) < 1e-6, na.rm = TRUE))
cut_summary
                     
cut_profile %>% print(row.names = FALSE)
save_table(cut_summary, "cutpoint_summary")
save_table(cut_profile, "cutpoint_profile")
save_table(cut_all_hr, "cutpoint_all_hr")
```

```{r}
  mutate(term = factor(term, levels = rev(focus_terms)))

  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = 2, colour = "#A7854E") +

                position = position_dodge(width = .5)) +

  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#537A98", "#CF7653"), labels = c("0-6 months", "After 6 months")) +

    subtitle = "Full A+B+C adjustment | grade/year-stratified baseline hazards",
    x = "Hazard ratio (95% CI)", y = NULL,

Exploratory grouped-model estimates; within-period PH must still be checked.") + project_plot_theme()
```

## 8. Piecewise Cox Regression Diagnostics

### Cox–Snell

```{r}
#| label: final-residuals
mart_initial <- as.numeric(residuals(m_initial, type = "martingale"))
mart_common <- as.numeric(residuals(m_common, type = "martingale"))
expected_early <- early_data$event_piece - as.numeric(residuals(m_early, type = "martingale"))
expected_late <- late_data$event_piece - as.numeric(residuals(m_late, type = "martingale"))
expected_final <- expected_early
expected_final[late_data$row_id] <- expected_final[late_data$row_id] + expected_late
residual_data <- dat %>% select(row_id, id, duration_months, event, loan_status, grade,
                                dti, revol_util, inq_last_6mths) %>%
  mutate(cox_snell_initial = pmax(0, event - mart_initial),
    cox_snell_common = pmax(0, event - mart_common),
    cox_snell_final = pmax(0, expected_final), martingale_final = event - cox_snell_final,
    deviance_final = sign(martingale_final) * sqrt(pmax(0, -2 *
      (martingale_final + event * log(pmax(cox_snell_final, .Machine$double.eps))))))
stopifnot(abs(sum(residual_data$martingale_final)) < 1e-4,
          all(residual_data$cox_snell_final >= 0))
cs_curve <- function(residual, event, model) {
  fit <- survfit(Surv(residual, event) ~ 1, stype = 2, ctype = 1, se.fit = FALSE)
  keep <- unique(round(seq(1, length(fit$time), length.out = min(2000L, length(fit$time)))))
  data.frame(model = model, residual = fit$time[keep], cumulative_hazard = fit$cumhaz[keep], at_risk = fit$n.risk[keep])
}
cs_data <- bind_rows(cs_curve(residual_data$cox_snell_initial, dat$event, "Initial MABC"),
  cs_curve(residual_data$cox_snell_common, dat$event, "Grade/year common"),
  cs_curve(residual_data$cox_snell_final, dat$event, "Final piecewise"))
cs_limit <- unname(quantile(residual_data$cox_snell_initial, .99))
cs_plot <- cs_data %>% filter(residual <= cs_limit) %>%
  ggplot(aes(residual, cumulative_hazard, colour = model)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "#A7854E") + geom_step(linewidth = .8) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#57A698", "#537A98", "#CF7653")) + coord_equal() +
  labs(title = "Cox-Snell residuals: overall model fit", x = "Cox-Snell residual",
    y = "Nelson-Aalen cumulative hazard", subtitle = "All models estimated on the full dataset",
    caption = "Curves show exact full-data estimates at a thinned display grid; central residual range only.
Agreement with the reference line does not establish PH or resolve proxy-time and censoring limitations.") + project_plot_theme()
cs_plot
save_figure(cs_plot, "06_cox_snell")
save_table(cs_data, "cox_snell_curves")
```

### Functional Form of Covariates with Martingale Residuals

```{r}
#| label: martingale-shape
set.seed(20261118)
scatter_rows <- sample.int(nrow(dat), min(15000L, nrow(dat)))
mart_bins <- list(); mart_points <- list()
for (variable in c("dti10", "log_annual_inc")) {
  reduced_terms <- setdiff(analysis_variables, variable)
  reduced_formula <- model_formula(reduced_terms, "piecewise")
  reduced_early <- coxph(reduced_formula, data = early_data, ties = "efron")
  reduced_late <- coxph(reduced_formula, data = late_data, ties = "efron")
  reduced_expected <- early_data$event_piece - as.numeric(residuals(reduced_early, type = "martingale"))
  reduced_expected[late_data$row_id] <- reduced_expected[late_data$row_id] +
    late_data$event_piece - as.numeric(residuals(reduced_late, type = "martingale"))
  z <- data.frame(value = dat[[variable]], martingale = dat$event - reduced_expected)
  mart_points[[variable]] <- z %>% slice(scatter_rows) %>% mutate(variable = variable)
  breaks <- unique(quantile(z$value, probs = seq(0, 1, length.out = 81)))
  bins <- z %>% mutate(bin = cut(value, breaks, include.lowest = TRUE)) %>% group_by(bin) %>%
    summarise(value = mean(value), martingale = mean(martingale), n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>% arrange(value) %>% as.data.frame()
  smoothed <- lowess(bins$value, bins$martingale, f = .35)
  bins <- bins %>% mutate(smooth = approx(smoothed$x, smoothed$y, xout = value, ties = mean, rule = 2)$y,
                          variable = variable)
  mart_bins[[variable]] <- bins
  rm(reduced_early, reduced_late)
}
mart_bins <- bind_rows(mart_bins)
mart_points <- bind_rows(mart_points)
mart_limits <- data.frame(variable = c("dti10", "log_annual_inc"),
  xmax = c(unname(quantile(dat$dti10, .995)), unname(quantile(dat$log_annual_inc, .995))))
mart_plot <- mart_points %>% left_join(mart_limits, by = "variable") %>% filter(value <= xmax) %>%
  ggplot(aes(value, martingale)) + geom_point(alpha = .08, size = .2, colour = "#537A98") +
  geom_line(data = mart_bins %>% left_join(mart_limits, by = "variable") %>% filter(value <= xmax),
    aes(y = smooth), linewidth = .9, colour = "#CF7653") + facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free_x") +
  labs(title = "Martingale residuals: inspect covariate shape", x = "Transformed covariate value",
    y = "Reduced-model martingale residual", caption = "Scatter: up to 15,000 loans; estimation and bin means: all loans. Central 99.5% x-range shown.") + project_plot_theme()
mart_zoom <- mart_bins %>% left_join(mart_limits, by = "variable") %>% filter(value <= xmax) %>%
  ggplot(aes(value, martingale)) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "#A7854E") +
  geom_point(aes(size = n), colour = "#537A98") + geom_line(aes(y = smooth), colour = "#CF7653") +
  facet_wrap(~variable, scales = "free") + scale_size_continuous(guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "Covariate-shape diagnostic: magnified bin means", x = "10-percentage-point units",
    y = "Mean martingale residual", caption = "Y axes differ and magnify small changes; not a formal test or a unique transformation rule.") + project_plot_theme()
mart_plot
mart_zoom
save_figure(mart_plot, "07_martingale")
save_figure(mart_zoom, "08_martingale_zoom")
save_table(mart_bins, "martingale_binned")
```

### Cumulative Score Processes Before and After the Proportional Hazards Adjustment

```{r}
#| label: ph-graphics
score_process <- list()
for (label in c("initial", "early", "late")) {
  model <- switch(label, initial = m_initial, early = m_early, late = m_late)
  sch <- residuals(model, type = "schoenfeld")
  selected <- intersect(credit_terms, colnames(sch))
  score_process[[label]] <- lapply(selected, function(term) {
    data.frame(time = as.numeric(rownames(sch)), contribution = sch[, term]) %>% group_by(time) %>%
      summarise(contribution = sum(contribution), .groups = "drop") %>% arrange(time) %>%
      mutate(process = cumsum(contribution) * sqrt(vcov(model)[term, term]), term = term, model = label) %>% as.data.frame()
  }) %>% bind_rows()
}
  
score_process <- bind_rows(score_process)
if (nrow(score_process)) {
  score_plot <- score_process %>% ggplot(aes(time, process)) + geom_line(colour = "#537A98") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "#A7854E") + facet_wrap(vars(model, term), scales = "free") +
    labs(title = "Score processes before and after refinement", x = "Months", y = "Standardized cumulative score",
      caption = "Systematic drift flags departures; separate panels use different scales and observation windows. No simultaneous bands.") + project_plot_theme()
  print(score_plot)
  save_figure(score_plot, "11_score_process", height = 10)
  save_table(score_process, "score_process")
}
rm(sch)
```

### Influential Observations in the Final Model with Score-Based DFBETAS

```{r}
#| label: influence
max_influence <- rep(0, nrow(dat)); affected_term <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(dat))
influence_terms <- list()
for (label in c("early", "late")) {
  model <- if (label == "early") m_early else m_late
  rows <- if (label == "early") early_data$row_id else late_data$row_id
  dfb <- residuals(model, type = "dfbetas")
  stopifnot(ncol(dfb) == length(coef(model)), nrow(dfb) == length(rows))
  colnames(dfb) <- names(coef(model))
  for (term in colnames(dfb)) {
    values <- abs(dfb[, term])
    larger <- values > max_influence[rows]
    max_influence[rows[larger]] <- values[larger]
    affected_term[rows[larger]] <- paste(label, term, sep = ":")
  }
  influence_terms[[label]] <- data.frame(period = label, term = colnames(dfb),
    max_abs_dfbetas = vapply(seq_len(ncol(dfb)), function(j) max(abs(dfb[, j])), numeric(1)))
  rm(dfb)
}

  mutate(max_abs_dfbetas = max_influence, affected_term = affected_term) %>% arrange(desc(max_abs_dfbetas))
```

### Sensitivity Analysis for the Final Model

```{r}
#| label: sensitivity
sensitivity_datasets <- list(
  without_late = dat %>% filter(!loan_status %in% c("Late (16-30 days)", "Late (31-120 days)")),
  utilization_le100 = dat %>% filter(revol_util <= 100),
  issued_through2014 = dat %>% filter(as.integer(as.character(issue_year)) <= 2014),
  financial_only = dat,
  omit_contract_group = dat,
  omit_background_group = dat,
  without_rare_housing = dat %>% filter(as.character(home_ownership) != "OTHER") %>%
    mutate(home_ownership = droplevels(home_ownership)),
  term_stratified = dat %>% mutate(year_grade = interaction(year_grade, term_months, sep = ":", drop = TRUE))
)
  
sensitivity_runs <- lapply(names(sensitivity_datasets), function(label) {
  dataset <- sensitivity_datasets[[label]]
  variables <- switch(label,
    financial_only = model_specs$MA,
    omit_contract_group = model_specs$MAC,
    omit_background_group = model_specs$MAB,
    term_stratified = setdiff(analysis_variables, "term_months"),
    analysis_variables)
  formula <- model_formula(variables, "piecewise")
  early <- dataset %>% mutate(tstart = 0, tstop = pmin(duration_months, split_month),
    event_piece = as.integer(event == 1 & duration_months <= split_month))
  late <- dataset %>% filter(duration_months > split_month) %>%
    mutate(tstart = split_month, tstop = duration_months, event_piece = event)
  e <- checked_coxph(formula, early, paste0(label, "_early"), ties = "efron")
  l <- checked_coxph(formula, late, paste0(label, "_late"), ties = "efron")
  status <- bind_rows(fit_status(e, paste0(label, "_early")) %>% mutate(period = "early_0_6"),
    fit_status(l, paste0(label, "_late")) %>% mutate(period = "late_after6")) %>%
    mutate(analysis = label) %>% as.data.frame()
  hr <- bind_rows(hr_table(e) %>% mutate(period = "early_0_6"),
    hr_table(l) %>% mutate(period = "late_after6")) %>% mutate(analysis = label) %>%
    left_join(status %>% select(period, fit_ok), by = "period") %>% as.data.frame()
  ph <- if (label == "term_stratified" && all(status$fit_ok)) bind_rows(
    ph_table(e, "term_stratified_early"), ph_table(l, "term_stratified_late")) %>% as.data.frame() else
    data.frame(model = character(), term = character(), chisq = numeric(), df = numeric(), p_value = numeric())
  list(hr = hr, status = status, ph = ph)
})
  
reference_hr <- final_hr %>% mutate(analysis = "all_loans", fit_ok = TRUE)
sensitivity_all_hr <- bind_rows(reference_hr,
  lapply(sensitivity_runs, function(z) z$hr) %>% bind_rows()) %>% as.data.frame()
         
sensitivity_fit_status <- lapply(sensitivity_runs, function(z) z$status) %>% bind_rows() %>% as.data.frame()
sensitivity_results <- sensitivity_all_hr %>% filter(term %in% focus_terms) %>% as.data.frame()
sensitivity_term_ph <- lapply(sensitivity_runs, function(z) z$ph) %>% bind_rows() %>% as.data.frame()
invisible(sensitivity_term_ph %>% filter(term == "GLOBAL"))
save_table(sensitivity_term_ph, "sensitivity_term_ph")
                              
sensitivity_reference <- reference_hr %>% select(period, term, HR_reference = HR, beta_reference = beta)
sensitivity_contrasts <- sensitivity_results %>% filter(analysis != "all_loans") %>%
  left_join(sensitivity_reference, by = c("period", "term")) %>%
  mutate(HR_ratio_to_reference = HR / HR_reference,
    HR_percent_change = 100 * (HR_ratio_to_reference - 1),
    absolute_logHR_change = abs(beta - beta_reference),
    logHR_ratio_to_reference = ifelse(abs(beta_reference) > .01, beta / beta_reference, NA_real_),
    same_direction = sign(beta) == sign(beta_reference)) %>% as.data.frame()
                              
sensitivity_summary <- sensitivity_contrasts %>% filter(fit_ok) %>% group_by(period, term) %>%
  summarise(n_valid_checks = n(), min_HR = min(HR), max_HR = max(HR),
    max_abs_HR_percent_change = max(abs(HR_percent_change)),
    max_abs_logHR_change = max(absolute_logHR_change),
    all_same_direction = all(same_direction), .groups = "drop") %>% as.data.frame()
sensitivity_fit_status
sensitivity_summary
                              
sensitivity_results %>% print(row.names = FALSE)
save_table(sensitivity_all_hr, "sensitivity_all_hr")
save_table(sensitivity_fit_status, "sensitivity_fit_status")
save_table(sensitivity_results, "sensitivity_results")
save_table(sensitivity_contrasts, "sensitivity_contrasts")
save_table(sensitivity_summary, "sensitivity_summary")
                              
sensitivity_plot <- sensitivity_results %>% filter(fit_ok) %>%
  mutate(primary = analysis == "all_loans") %>%
  ggplot(aes(HR, analysis, colour = primary)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 1, linetype = 2, colour = "#A8B5BE") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), orientation = "y", width = .15) +
  geom_point(size = 2.3) + facet_wrap(vars(term, period), scales = "free_x", ncol = 2) +
  scale_x_log10() + scale_colour_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#91A9B8", "TRUE" = "#365D78"), guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "Grouped Cox: sensitivity of key associations", x = "Hazard ratio (95% CI)", y = NULL,
    caption = "Selected 6-month split and grade/year strata. Group-omission checks change the adjustment set.
Without-late restricts both outcome definition and sample; intervals are exploratory and nominal.") + project_plot_theme()
                              
sensitivity_plot
save_figure(sensitivity_plot, "16_grouped_sensitivity", height = 9)
```

## 10. Supplementary Analysis of Competing Risks

### Event Definitions and Target of Estimation

- After origination, each loan is assumed to transition to the first observed outcome, either the composite delinquency or default event (`event_type=1`) or repayment in full (`event_type=2`).

- A value of 0 for `event_type` indicates the end of follow-up. Repayment in full is a competing event because it precludes subsequent delinquency or default on the same loan.

- The Fully Paid status does not distinguish early repayment from repayment at maturity, so both are treated as repayment in full.

- The data cannot reconstruct prior delinquencies followed by recovery or repayment. The estimates therefore describe cumulative incidence for the outcomes defined in preprocessing using the last payment month as a proxy for event time. Estimating lifetime risk of first delinquency would require complete delinquency histories.

```{r}
#| label: cr-integrated-setup
cr_covariates <- analysis_variables
primary_hr <- final_hr
primary_ph_overview <- ph_overview
cause_labels <- c(distress = "Distress", paid = "Fully paid")
dat <- dat %>% mutate(cr_status = factor(event_type, levels = c(0, 1, 2), labels = c("censored", "distress", "paid")))
event_counts <- dat %>% count(cr_status, name = "n") %>% mutate(percent = 100*n/sum(n)) %>% as.data.frame()
event_counts
save_table(event_counts, "cr_event_counts")
```

### A. Aalen–Johansen Cumulative Incidence by Credit Grade

We use `cmprsk::cuminc()` to estimate the cumulative incidence function for each event type.

```{r}
#| label: aj-models
ci_grade <- cmprsk::cuminc(ftime = dat$duration_months, fstatus = dat$event_type,
  group = dat$grade, cencode = 0, rho = 0)

ci_overall <- cmprsk::cuminc(ftime = dat$duration_months, fstatus = dat$event_type,
  cencode = 0)

ci_stratified <- cmprsk::cuminc(ftime = dat$duration_months,
  fstatus = dat$event_type, group = dat$grade, strata = dat$issue_year,
  cencode = 0, rho = 0)

ci_extract <- function(fit, times = NULL, grouped = TRUE) {
  keys <- setdiff(names(fit), "Tests")
  lapply(keys, function(key) {
    fields <- strsplit(key, " ", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    grade_value <- if (grouped) fields[1] else "All"
    cause <- if (tail(fields, 1) == "1") "distress" else "paid"
    curve <- fit[[key]]
    group_time <- if (grouped) dat$duration_months[as.character(dat$grade) == grade_value] else dat$duration_months
    if (is.null(times)) {
      keep <- !duplicated(curve$time, fromLast = TRUE)
      month <- curve$time[keep]; estimate <- curve$est[keep]; variance <- curve$var[keep]
    } else {
      if (any(times > max(group_time))) stop("Requested CIF exceeds observed support")
      point <- cmprsk::timepoints(fit, times)
      month <- times; estimate <- as.numeric(point$est[key, ]); variance <- as.numeric(point$var[key, ])
    }
    risk <- vapply(month, function(t) sum(group_time >= t), numeric(1))
    data.frame(grade = grade_value, month = month, at_risk = risk, cause = cause, CIF = estimate,
      lower = pmax(0, estimate - qnorm(.975)*sqrt(pmax(variance, 0))),
      upper = pmin(1, estimate + qnorm(.975)*sqrt(pmax(variance, 0))))
  }) %>% bind_rows() %>% as.data.frame()
}
aj_curve <- ci_extract(ci_grade)
aj_summary <- ci_extract(ci_grade, c(12,24,36)) %>% arrange(grade, month, cause) %>% as.data.frame()
aj_overall_summary <- ci_extract(ci_overall, c(12,24,36), grouped = FALSE)
         
probability_check <- merge(subset(aj_summary, cause == "distress"),
  subset(aj_summary, cause == "paid"), by = c("grade", "month"))
stopifnot(all(probability_check$CIF.x + probability_check$CIF.y <= 1+1e-10))
         
aj_summary %>% print(row.names = FALSE)
save_table(aj_curve, "cr_aj_curves")
save_table(aj_summary, "cr_aj_summary")
save_table(aj_overall_summary, "cr_aj_overall_summary")

aj_plot <- aj_curve %>% filter(month <= 36) %>%
  mutate(cause = factor(cause, levels = names(cause_labels), labels = cause_labels)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(month, CIF, colour = grade)) + geom_step(linewidth = .9) +
  facet_wrap(~ cause, nrow = 1) + scale_colour_manual(values = grade_colours) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,36,6), limits = c(0,36)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(title = "A. Two competing loan outcomes",
    subtitle = "cmprsk cumulative incidence estimates by credit grade",
    x = "Months since origination", y = "Cumulative incidence",
    caption = "Unadjusted estimates with last-payment proxy times; longer follow-up reflects older cohorts.")
         
aj_plot
save_figure(aj_plot, "cr_01_cif_by_grade", height = 6.5)
```

```{r}
#| label: aj-slide-table
aj_slide_table <- aj_summary %>% select(grade, month, at_risk, cause, CIF) %>%
  { merge(filter(., cause == "distress") %>% select(-cause) %>% rename(distress_CIF = CIF),
      filter(., cause == "paid") %>% select(grade, month, paid_CIF = CIF),
      by = c("grade", "month"), sort = FALSE) } %>%
  mutate(distress_percent = round(100 * distress_CIF, 2),
    paid_percent = round(100 * paid_CIF, 2),
    event_free_percent = round(100 * (1 - distress_CIF - paid_CIF), 2)) %>%
  select(grade, month, at_risk, distress_percent, paid_percent, event_free_percent) %>%
  arrange(grade, month) %>% as.data.frame()
  
aj_slide_table %>% print(row.names = FALSE)
save_table(aj_slide_table, "cr_aj_slide_table")
```

### B. Comparison of 1−KM and Cumulative Incidence

```{r}
#| label: km-cif-comparison
km <- survfit(Surv(duration_months, event) ~ grade, data = dat)

km_extract <- function(times = NULL) {
  s <- if (is.null(times)) summary(km, censored = TRUE) else summary(km, times = times)
  data.frame(grade = sub("^grade=", "", as.character(s$strata)), month = s$time,
    net_risk = 1 - s$surv)
}

km_cif <- aj_summary %>% filter(cause == "distress") %>%
  left_join(km_extract(c(12, 24, 36)), by = c("grade", "month")) %>%
  mutate(gap_percentage_points = 100 * (net_risk - CIF)) %>% as.data.frame()
stopifnot(!anyNA(km_cif$net_risk), all(km_cif$gap_percentage_points >= -1e-8))

km_cif %>% select(grade, month, at_risk, CIF, net_risk, gap_percentage_points) %>% print(row.names = FALSE)

comparison_curve <- bind_rows(
  aj_curve %>% filter(cause == "distress") %>%
    transmute(grade, month, probability = CIF, method = "AJ cumulative incidence"),
  km_extract() %>% transmute(grade, month, probability = net_risk, method = "1 - KM (net risk)"),
  data.frame(grade = LETTERS[1:7], month = 0, probability = 0, method = "1 - KM (net risk)")) %>%
  arrange(grade, method, month) %>% as.data.frame()

comparison_plot <- comparison_curve %>% filter(month <= 36) %>%
  ggplot(aes(month, probability, linetype = method, colour = method)) +
  geom_step(linewidth = .85) + facet_wrap(~ grade, nrow = 2) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("AJ cumulative incidence" = "#365D78", "1 - KM (net risk)" = "#93A7B5")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("AJ cumulative incidence" = 1, "1 - KM (net risk)" = 2)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 12, 24, 36)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(title = "B. Net risk and cumulative incidence differ",
    subtitle = "Same distress definition and follow-up; different handling of completed repayment",
    x = "Months since origination", y = "Distress probability / net risk",
    caption = "AJ incorporates fully paid loans as a competing outcome. Both curves use proxy event times.")

comparison_plot
save_table(km_cif, "cr_km_vs_cif")
save_figure(comparison_plot, "cr_02_km_vs_cif", height = 8)
```

### Gray tests with cmprsk

```{r}
#| label: gray-tests
extract_gray <- function(fit, adjustment) {
  z <- as.data.frame(fit$Tests)
  data.frame(cause = ifelse(rownames(z) == "1", "distress", "paid"),
    adjustment = adjustment, chisq = z$stat, df = z$df, p_value = z$pv,
    p_display = format.pval(z$pv, digits = 3, eps = .001), row.names = NULL)
}

gray_results <- bind_rows(extract_gray(ci_grade, "Unstratified"),
  extract_gray(ci_stratified, "Stratified by issue_year")) %>% as.data.frame()
gray_results %>% print(row.names = FALSE)
save_table(gray_results, "cr_gray_tests")
```
